findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 1
Raise: Not done. When a part exceeds its size limit on its first close, `stuck_stop` records the choice and reaches `share_wait` before a pull request exists. This branch only publishes when `branch_pr` finds an existing PR, then refuses. The choice stays local instead of opening a PR and appearing in both machines’ Needs you lists. The new size-choice test starts with an existing PR, so it misses this path.
findings.title: Not done: publish a size choice on the first close

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 1
Raise: Functional. The shared answer clears the asking machine’s local question only when `forge work` runs here. `close.py:143-145` still reads that stale local question and refuses before consulting the PR record. After a teammate answers and publishes the wait’s end, the original machine can show no worker-question wait yet still cannot close the item.
findings.title: An answer from another machine still blocks close on the asking machine

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 1
Raise: Functional. A teammate can answer the open question selected from the PR record here, but later `worker.py:172` takes the question only from that machine’s local Codex record. On a fresh clone it is absent, so `_brief` receives the answer without the question and omits its pending-question section. The worker cannot tell what an answer such as “Yes, reuse it” refers to.
